headline: Fisherman's Row Erupts as Fighting Surges Across The Gutter
war_summary: Fisherman’s Row has experienced a sharp surge in frontline movement, tallying nine strategic base exchanges over the past two hours contested across Black Well, Dankana Post, Fort Ember, and Eidolo. The Gutter has abruptly reawakened after a quiet spell, logging five rapid base turnovers centered on The Parras. Severe friction continues unabated in Weathered Expanse, where six base actions in the latest two-hour window around Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch have pushed combined casualties above 3,400, leaving the sector divided and one position unoccupied. Fresh base engagements also stirred Linn of Mercy at Lathair and Rotdust, reducing one installation to neutral ground. Meanwhile, Stonecradle and Dead Lands continue to generate massive casualty figures—exceeding 4,300 and 2,300 respectively over the last two hours—even as direct territorial transitions pause across both sectors. Mooring County similarly reports rapidly accelerating casualty rates alongside high troop arrivals, whereas combat activity in Farranac Coast has perceptibly cooled following earlier clashes.
